Hi, I'm Jaclyn! 

I'm currently a Master of Data Science student at UBC, specializing in Computational Linguistics. Before MDS, I worked in the financial services industry and completed my MBA at UBC Sauder. I'm interested in the intersection of artificial intelligence, data science, and business. Through MDS, I hope to build the technical skills to complement my business background and pursue opportunities in the technology industry.
